Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry spike and IRP / evidence request — Meridian Bank

Sarah / AuditOps team —

Quick heads-up: our monitoring picked up a sustained telemetry spike tied to a high-rate token-auth pattern from a small set of Meridian tenant API keys between 2027-06-06 23:40 UTC and 2027-06-07 00:05 UTC. We isolated the activity to a single job that was making unusually long-context requests; we do not have evidence of data exfiltration at this time.

Request: Meridian has asked for an IRP summary and a small evidence bundle (telemetry slice, auth logs, and a short timeline) for their internal audit / SIG mapping. Can we provide the initial artifacts and an IRP timeline by EOD today?

I'll coordinate redaction and SFTP delivery. Attaching a small telemetry snippet for immediate review (redwood_telemetry_snippet.log).

Next steps we propose:
- Internal triage note (we'll produce an IR timeline + root-cause hypothesis) — internal owner: Marissa
- Deliver sanitized artifacts to Meridian via SFTP — owner: Karthik
- SIG / CAIQ crosswalk for their SOC2 auditor — owner: Neha

Sarah, if you want more granular data or a different delivery method (Box/Drive/DocuSign for NDA), say the word and we'll align.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_telemetry_snippet.log (text, 45KB)

From: Sarah.Mills <sarah.mills@meridianbank.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.example
Cc: auditops@auditops.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry spike and IRP / evidence request — Meridian Bank

Thanks Jonas — and thanks for the quick flag.

We appreciate the proactive outreach. For our SOC2 evidence stream the audit team will need:
- A short IR timeline (start/end, detection, containment actions, current status)
- Auth logs (UTC timestamps) and any IP addresses observed
- Any relevant runbook notes or pager rotations if an oncall was engaged
- A SIG/CAIQ mapping that shows where controls were exercised or not

Delivery: SFTP is fine — we'll provide credentials for a temporary account. Please also include a PII redaction note for any user-identifying fields (we require hashed IDs).

For prioritization: the auditors will want the timeline and auth logs first; if you can get those by EOD today that would be ideal. Once we review, we may request a brief postmortem writeup for our internal board packet.

—Sarah
Sarah Mills
CISO, Meridian Bank

AuditOps also confirming receipt of the snippet and availability to accept SFTP artifacts.

AuditOps <auditops@auditops.com>

What you'll get by 17:00 PT (EOD Redwood):
- IR timeline draft (ir_timeline_v1.pdf) — includes detection timestamps, triage actions, and current status
- Auth logs (UTC, CSV subset) — redacted for PII, hashed user ids included
- Telemetry snippet (already shared) and expanded log slice if needed

Delivery mechanism: sftp://evidence.redwood.example/meridian/20270607 — temporary folder created; we'll provision credentials and email them to the AuditOps contact. Karthik will manage the upload and permissions.

If AuditOps needs an encrypted archive instead, we can provide a password-protected tarball and a separate key exchange.

Marissa
